messages:
mira: Heads-up — onboarding SilverBirch-3B to the eval harness. Chat-template tests are failing token alignment and the quantized runner is crashing intermittently. Anyone seen this pattern before?

alex: Saw something similar with Orion — often utf8/normalization or special-token mismatches. Can you paste a minimal failing example?

mira: Sure — here's a tiny repro from the harness (trimmed):
```
Prompt: "User: Here's the list: • item1 • item2"
Tokenized (silverbirch tokenizer): ["Here", "'s", "the", "list", ":", "Â", "•", "item", "1", ...]
Expected (harness preproc): ["Here", "'s", "the", "list", ":", "•", "item", "1", ...]
```

jonathan: That "Â" screams encoding/normalization issue (NFC vs NFKC). Which tokenizer lib is silverbirch using? sentencepiece/bpe/tiktoken? Also what's model_config.json set to for normalization?

mira: SilverBirch uses a tiny custom BPE. model_config.json currently has `do_normalize: false` because the tokenizer authors wanted to preserve some glyphs. The harness assumes `do_normalize: true`.

priya: Two angles here: (1) enable NFKC normalization in the tokenizer or add a lightweight normalizer in the harness preprocessing pipeline; (2) the chat-template itself is using an assistant sentinel `### Assistant` but the model metadata expects `<|assistant|>`. That mismatch can break prefix/KV caching in the quantized codepath.

sam: Example from CI flake log (quant runner):
```
EVAL RUNNER ERROR: KeyError: prefix_0 not found
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "eval_runner.py", line 412, in run_case
    cache = kv_cache[prefix_key]
KeyError: 'prefix_0'
# followed by an assertion failure: tokens between fp32 and q8n differ for sentinel token
```

mira: Ok — makes sense. I can flip `do_normalize` to true and remap the sentinel in the model_onboard.yaml. Would that be the recommended path?

choi: Short-term workaround that reduced flakes for us: add `token_aliases` in the harness to map `"<|assistant|>" -> "### Assistant"` (or vice-versa) during token id lookup. This buys time while the model tarball gets fixed. But long-term we should make the harness validate model metadata vs harness expectations.

ci-bot: FYI I've queued a CI patch that will add a tokenizer-consistency unit test on PRs that touch onboarding yaml. Patch: https://git.redwood/silverbirch/onboard/merge/1234 (runs normalization check + sentinel id parity)

priya: Also: quantized execution (q8n path) assumes identical special token ids across quantized and fp32 checkpoints. Add an explicit assertion in the quant test harness that `ids_fp32[special_tokens] == ids_q8n[special_tokens]` before running long evals. Saves a lot of CI minutes.

alex: I'll take the token_aliases + harness fallback patch. Mira — can you submit the model_onboard.yaml change to enable normalization and update the sentinel mapping? If you want I can open a PR that adds a small migration script to rewrite existing tarballs in staging. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll add the quant consistency test to `/eval/tests/consistency/silverbirch_echo.py` and wire it into the q8n job.

mira: Thanks, all — I'll PR the model config now and link the onboard CI run here. If CI still flakes after the harness fallback + normalizer I'll ping for a deeper kv-cache trace.

alex: :+1:

choi: small note — when you flip normalization, run the tokenizer round-trip test with ZWJ/combining marks (we had a corner case where emoticon clusters split differently).

mira: good call. will do.
